title: Unit Type Categories

help.title: About Unit Type Categories
help.overview: A Unit type category is a grouping label for unit types (for example residential versus commercial). It has only a name. Units do not pick a category themselves — they pick a unit type, and that type belongs to a category.

sections.title: What a category holds
items: Name (required). There are no other fields.

sections.title: On this page
items: Delete is a soft delete, but it is blocked while any unit type still uses this category. Reassign or remove those types first.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Create categories before the unit types that need them. A unit type cannot be saved without a category.
Renaming a category updates the label everywhere that type is shown. It does not change units or prices.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create unit types under those categories.
When you add units, pick a unit type — the category comes along with the type.
